system.description: Usage held in 1 hand; Activate Interact (2 AP). Terrain: cold swamps, fog lands and haunted coasts. Mistwraith bloom is a pallid, weightless flower found in cold wetlands and along haunted, fog-bound shores. It has no visible stem at dawn, seeming to float a finger's breadth above the water until direct sunlight touches it. When the prepared petals are crushed and inhaled, they dissolve into cold mist that spills across the user's skin. You become Invisible for 1 minute. The effect ends after you use a hostile action. Pillars of Faith, Chapter 6.

effects.text: You are undetected (creatures can Search to make you hidden). The effect ends after you use a hostile action.
